lastCompletedStory.title: Implementer runs file-size gate and raises its own ceilings in-story

nextStoryContext: US-001 added a `bun scripts/check-file-sizes.ts` gate step (with raise-and-retry instructions scoped to the story's own grown files) to both copies of the implementer instruction file, in the '## What you do for the story' quality-gates list. Neither .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md nor templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md was already listed in scripts/file-size-budget.json, so this story's own edit did not trip the gate; if a future story pushes either file over a ceiling, follow the raise-and-retry procedure this story just documented (actual line count via the gate itself, not `wc -l`; tracker ref staged in the same diff as the budget change). The two agent-instruction copies are legitimately non-byte-identical (dual-copy convention, see patterns.md) — matching instructions were added to each in their own existing style, not a verbatim mirror.
